description:
## Empirical anchor (2026-05-17, Arc 37 close)

PLINY-the-stoa squash-merged PR #17 via:
  `gh pr merge 17 --squash --delete-branch --subject "..." --body "..."`
with a custom `--body` describing the gauntlet outcome. The squash-merge commit on main (bb12806) does NOT carry the Co-Authored-By trailers from the source branch's 4 commits (ADA + DAEDALUS), even though all 4 source commits correctly carried trailers per §28.

`git log -1 --format='%B' bb12806 | grep -c 'Co-Authored-By'` returns 0.

The §28.3 canon expectation (just shipped in Arc 35) is: 'GitHub's squash-merge behavior auto-populates a Co-Authored-By trailer from each squashed commit's author AND preserves any pre-existing Co-Authored-By trailers from the squashed commits' bodies into the squash-merge commit's body.'

What broke: when `--body` is passed to `gh pr merge --squash`, it OVERRIDES the default body (which would be the concatenation of source commits, including their trailers). PLINY's custom body had a clean summary but no trailer lines.

## The fix (substrate convention)

Future squash-merges of arc PRs MUST either:
1. Omit `--body` (let GitHub auto-populate from source commits — preserves trailers), OR
2. Include the trailers explicitly in the `--body` HEREDOC.

Light-touch substrate convention: extend `MAJOR_PLINY.md` §5.10 + §6 ship-checklist with a one-line note. Optionally extend `operating-disciplines.md` §28.3 with a 'trailer-preservation pitfall' subsection naming this regression as empirical anchor.

## Scope

- 1 line in `MAJOR_PLINY.md` §5.10 (ship-checklist convention)
- Optional 1 paragraph in `operating-disciplines.md` §28.3.1 (pitfall + worked-example)

Suitable for inclusion in Arc 39 (small bundled follow-ups per the Pass-5 workplan) OR as a direct fix in a small standalone arc.

## Cross-references

- Arc 35 squash-merge of stoa--ezo (where §28 originally shipped) — verify whether THAT squash-merge preserved trailers; if yes, Arc 35 used the default --body OR included trailers explicitly.
- Arc 37 squash-merge bb12806 — the regression anchor.
- operating-disciplines.md §28.3 — the canon expectation that broke.

## Out of scope

- Retroactively amending bb12806 (force-push to main; NEVER without explicit authorization). The Arc 37 source commits at the branch tip e7a94c6 (deleted local + remote) retain the trailers; if anyone wants to walk the trailer chain, the branch is recoverable from the merged PR.
- Building tooling enforcement (no pre-commit hook; convention is the layer).
title: Squash-merge body --body override drops Co-Authored-By trailers — Arc 37 regression
